changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestnormalrangelov AS SELECT dtnrl.id, dtnrl.normal_range_id, dtnrl.lov FROM public.diagnostic_test_normal_range_lov dtnrl;

changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
